name: 92675 · San Juan Capo, CA
findings: ZIP 92675 (San Juan Capo) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92675 (San Juan Capo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
